raw_preprocessing.center: feature cache window_relative_centers_sec, nominal onset midpoint of 60-second raw cache
raw_preprocessing.normalization: per-channel-window temporal mean and standard deviation with 1e-6 minimum; clip to [-8,8]
raw_preprocessing.onset_provenance_limitation: cache fields include onset and valid interval but no explicit onset-centered flag; source constructor places onset at raw midpoint, subject to provenance verification

models.M0_A1: existing exact A1 source and fixed-query replay
models.M1_RAWTINY_NOPR: parallel depthwise convolution raw 32D -> exact A1 temporal/seizure mean pooling -> shared channel classifier, no patient context
models.M2_RAWTINY_PR: same raw encoder/init as M1 -> exact A1 temporal/seizure mean pooling -> absolute+z+detached-percentile -> one attention block -> classifier
models.M3_HYBRID_PR: A1 fold epoch30 checkpoint frozen; zero alpha raw 32D residual at A1 window embedding; zero-output absolute+z+rank attention logit residual; train only raw and residual parameters

rawtiny.rank: exact label-free percentile forward; smooth-rank straight-through gradient with fixed temperature 0.1 trains shared scalar scorer; no label input
rawtiny.attention: one 2-head channel self-attention block, no positional encoding

training.loss: exact A1 patient-equal weighted BCE, EZ:NEZ 2:1
training.M3_initialization: A1 fold epoch30 trained only on FIT subjects; alpha and PR correction exactly zero at step0
training.resume: private epoch checkpoints only; no checkpoint/cache on Git

selection.rule: exact A1 leave-one-validation-patient-out checkpoint and threshold selection on 30 epoch score grids
selection.deviation_reason: The request also requires exact A1 fixed-query/VLOO reproduction; FIT-only epoch selection is incompatible with that frozen baseline. Matched A1 VLOO takes precedence for the primary comparison. This is an explicit protocol limitation, not a concealed change.

evaluation.interpretation: exploratory development, not fresh sealed confirmation
